env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build ./...
logos test -count=1 -v ./...
stdout '^--- PASS: TestControlInternal '
stdout '^--- PASS: TestColumnsExternal '

# SPEC: an expansion at or below the selected limit MUST compile,
# whichever file triggered the instantiation.

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/copyrt

go 1.27

-- w/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import (
	"comptime"
	"errors"
)

type Item struct {
	Name string?
}

func ColumnsOf[E any]() ([]string, error) {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[E]() {
		out := []string{}
		const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[E]() {
			kind, ok := Probe[f.Type]()
			if !ok {
				return nil, errors.New("lib: unsupported field")
			}
			out = append(out, kind)
		}
		return out, nil
	} else {
		comptime.Error("lib: entity must be a struct")
	}
	return nil, errors.New("lib: unreachable")
}

func Probe[F any]() (string, bool) {
	const switch F {
	case string:
		return "s", true
	case string?:
		return "opt", true
	}
	return "", false
}

-- w/lib/control.lgo --
package lib

func Control() (int, error) {
	cols, err := ColumnsOf[Item]()
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return len(cols), nil
}

-- w/lib/intern_test.lgo --
package lib

import "testing"

func TestControlInternal(t *testing.T) {
	n, err := Control()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Control: err = %v", err)
	}
	if n != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("Control: n = %d, want 1", n)
	}
}

-- w/lib/extern_test.lgo --
package lib_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/copyrt/lib"
)

func TestColumnsExternal(t *testing.T) {
	cols, err := lib.ColumnsOf[lib.Item]()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ColumnsOf: err = %v", err)
	}
	if len(cols) != 1 || cols[0] != "opt" {
		t.Fatalf("ColumnsOf: cols = %v, want [opt]", cols)
	}
}

-- w/app/app.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/copyrt/lib"
)

func main() {
	cols, err := lib.ColumnsOf[lib.Item]()
	if err == nil && len(cols) == 1 && cols[0] == "opt" {
		fmt.Println("cols 1 opt")
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("BAD", err)
}
